title: Scrapegraph AI open-source data scraping tool launches for free use #shorts #scrapegraph #ai
description: Scrapegraph AI is a free, open-source Python library designed to simplify web data extraction. It enables users to input a website URL and specify their desired information in plain English, delivering a structured list of results within minutes. With over 30,000 stars on GitHub, this tool supports major AI coding agents, including Claude Code, making data scraping accessible and efficient. Ideal for professionals in sales, marketing, and data analysis, Scrapegraph AI automates the collection of leads, competitor insights, ads monitoring, and research by extracting structured data fields like names, emails, prices, and product details. The output is ready for integration into spreadsheets or automated workflows, saving time and enhancing productivity. For access, comment "Cloud" to receive the direct link. #ScrapegraphAI #OpenSourcePython #WebScraping #DataAutomation #ClaudeCode #LeadGeneration #CompetitiveAnalysis #MarketingTools #SalesEnablement #DataExtraction #AICodingAgents #ResearchTools #StructuredData #Automation #FreeSoftware
